headline: CFA Romania estimates 0.1% economic growth in 2026 and a euro at 5.3628 lei in 12 months
summary: CFA Romania expects economic growth of 0.1% in 2026, a euro exchange rate of 5.3628 lei in 12 months, and public debt at 63% of GDP. These are forecasts from the analyst association.
why: CFA Romania is the local chapter of the CFA Institute, and its forecasts inform investor views on Romania's growth, currency and fiscal position.
